Our soldiers should be training to defend this country. Not mowing lawns and cleaning bathrooms.

For 15 years a government-wide freeze has blocked the military from hiring outside contractors for basic facility services. The result: commanders pulling troops off training schedules to do janitorial work.

Our NDAA amendment ends this. Soldiers belong on the training field. Not the lawn.
